name: Ano Hi Mita Hana no Namae o Bokutachi wa Mada Shiranai.
original_name: あの日見た花の名前を僕達はまだ知らない。
source:
6 girls and boys create a group called 'Super Piece Buster'. They were unseparated until one of them, Honma "Menma" Meiko passed away and separated her 5 friends. 

10 years later, Menma appears in front of her now grownup friend Yadomi "Jintan" Jinta. Menma asks Jintan to fulfill a wish that she can’t remember to move on to the next life. That’s where you come in.

The PSP game has a branching story and multiple endings made just for the game. On top of the visual novel component, this game has a communication mini-game where you can talk to a 3D model of Menma everyday.

[edited from [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2012/05/02/anohana-the-flower-we-saw-that-day-game-coming-to-psp-with-multiple-endings/]SiliconEra[/url]]
translation:
六個男孩女孩組成了名為「超和平Busters」的團體。他們形影不離，直到綽號「麵麻」的本間芽衣子去世，其餘五人才分道揚鑣。

10年後，麵麻出現在了已經長大的朋友宿海仁太（仁太哥）面前。麵麻請求仁太幫她完成一個她自己都記不清的願望，好讓她能夠前往來世。而你，就是那個關鍵人物。

PSP遊戲擁有專為遊戲製作的分支劇情和多結局。除了視覺小說部分外，遊戲還有一個交流迷你遊戲，你可以每天與麵麻的3D模型對話。
